blinding_note: The source publication was inspected during candidate selection and already states that sensory diversity changes with ambient ligand context. No directional result from this experiment may be described as prospectively blinded confirmation.
construction_order: whole Bio Chi event -> minimum required internal organization -> optional scalar compression

source.article_title: Signal integration and adaptive sensory diversity tuning in Escherichia coli chemotaxis

biological_event.whole_event: background-conditioned reorganization of the population sensory-sensitivity distribution measured by single-cell FRET dose response
biological_event.target_observable_power: source-established; the publication directly measures single-cell sensitivity distributions across background conditions

source_native_processing.response_summary: median post-stimulus FRET activity divided by cell baseline activity, following source code
source_native_processing.cdf_definition: P(K_half < L) approximated by fraction of single-cell median normalized post-stimulus responses below 0.5
source_native_processing.distribution_family: lognormal CDF in ligand units, parameterized by log-location mu and log-scale sigma

representation_tests.Chi_bio: minimum vector representation is initially the source-native distribution state (mu_logK, sigma_logK); this may be simplified or refused by the result
representation_tests.chi_bio: NOT_OPENED_AT_FREEZE. No mechanical/dynamical scalar is licensed by the source merely from dose-response sensitivity.
representation_tests.scalar_compression_control: evaluate whether a one-coordinate location-only representation with shared dispersion loses predictive information relative to the two-coordinate distribution representation; do not relabel this control as chi_bio

primary_outputs: source-native mu_logK and sigma_logK for each frozen background
background-wise empirical CDF points and uncertainty

decision_rules.Bio_Chi_admission: requires reproducible background-conditioned distribution reorganization in the frozen source-native analysis; literature agreement alone is not sufficient if source reproduction fails
decision_rules.Chi_bio_admission: requires that at least two nonredundant distribution coordinates are needed to represent the frozen whole event or that a simpler vector representation is demonstrably sufficient; report the minimum supported representation
decision_rules.chi_bio_admission: requires an independently licensed dynamical scalar carrier. Absent that license, return NOT_LICENSED or NOT_REQUIRED rather than inventing a scalar.
decision_rules.failed_whole_event_rule: lower-level mathematics cannot rescue a failed whole-event reproduction
decision_rules.post_result_rule: any threshold, alternate file selection, added feature, or new mechanistic interpretation opened after result inspection is exploratory and carries promotion debt

stop_conditions: raw source files do not match frozen identities
source data cannot reproduce the declared normalized-response object without altering source logic
material change to biological event, file set, endpoint, or representation decision rule would be required
new dynamical scalar would require a model not independently licensed by the source
